title: odontonema paniculatum
intro: Odontonema paniculatum, commonly known as Firecracker Plant or Purple Firecracker, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae, native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is known for its vibrant purple flowers and is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
